requirements: This action is pinned to PS4 firmware 9.00. Use the original stable ftp_server_v1.08b.bin above; the older GamerHack FTP file is a different binary.
Start compatible GoldHEN on the PS4, enable its HTTP BinLoader on port 9090 and pair the desktop sender. Load requires selecting the exact downloaded BIN.
The FTP server listens on port 1337. After the console reports its address, connect an FTP client on the same local network to that address and port.
Do not start a second FTP server on port 1337 or send this payload again while it is running. Use the custom FTP command SHUTDOWN to stop it.
A completed transfer confirms bytes sent, not execution. Check the console's FTP notification before using the server or loading another payload.

loaderEvidence.source: The FTP author's pinned 9.00 host names this FTP source and sends ftp.bin through GoldHEN HTTP9090. Only dumper.bin, history_blocker.bin and web_activator.bin are diverted to WebKit. The FTP author's discussion separately confirms manual FTP payload loading on 9.00 with GoldHEN's BinLoader. The stable source builds a native position-independent flat BIN with a self-initializing _main entry.
